onset.Description: Onset of the event, in seconds, measured from the start of the recording.

duration.Description: Duration of the event. The source `EEG.event` struct stamps a 1-sample duration on every trigger; that 1-sample value is not a meaningful duration and is recorded here as `n/a` to indicate an instantaneous trigger event.

sample.Description: Sample index of the event in the recording's EEG signal (0-based, computed as `round(onset * sfreq)` with `sfreq = 500 Hz` as declared in `task-motorimagery_eeg.json`).

value.Description: Verbatim event label from the source dataset's EEG.event struct (the `.set` file's event table). The source dataset does not publish a code-to-meaning mapping for the per-trial markers; the README documents the trial structure (3 s fixation, 4 s visual cue, 3 s ready state, 5 s motor-imagery period; 40 trials per session; four MI tasks Reach/Grasp/Lift/Twist presented in random order) but does not state which `S` code corresponds to which phase or task.

Levels.boundary: EEGLAB-internal data-discontinuity marker. Stamped automatically by EEGLAB at concatenation points; not a stimulus or response event. Appears once per recording, at sample 0.
Levels.S 1: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears once per recording near the file start; not documented in the source dataset's README or sidecars.
Levels.S 2: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 40 times per recording (matching the 40 trials per session described in the README); not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 3: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 10 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 4: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 10 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 5: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 10 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 6: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 10 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset. (The four codes S 3 / S 4 / S 5 / S 6 each appearing 10 times per session matches the README's description of four MI tasks Reach / Grasp / Lift / Twist with 10 trials each, but the source does not publish which code maps to which task.)
Levels.S 7: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 40 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 8: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 40 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 9: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 40 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.S 10: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears 40 times per recording; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
Levels.condition 12: Trigger code from the source EEG.event struct. Appears once per recording near the file end; not explicitly documented in the source dataset.
